title: The Stop-hook report-shape guard stays quiet on a turn that lands nothing
why: The report-shape Stop hook fired on a turn with no commit, push or merge, though rule reports-no-report-when-nothing-landed says such a turn gives no report (lane other-checkout-cp-own (session_013NEJL3R2CBFavz7grtbJY8); coordinator, 04:13 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: the report-shape guard reads the turn's landing acts first and skips a turn with no commit, push, merge or opened PR. Red case first: a one-line turn with no landing act is refused today; control: a turn that pushes and ends with no report still refuses (step tracking-turn-report-clash). Owner: lane other-checkout-cp-own, a fix in that lane (coordinator, 04:13 CST Nov 8). Queue fix. Filed 04:20 CST Nov 8.
